sloka: सो ऽश्वान् रज्वाथ चतुरो रथे युङ्क्त्वा मनोजवान् ।आरोहस्वेति वैदेहीं सूतः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् ।। ७.४६.२१ ॥
transliteration: so 'śvān rajvātha caturo rathe yuṅktvā manojavān ।ārohasveti vaidehīṁ sūtaḥ prāñjalirabravīt ।। 7.46.21 ॥

translations.english: The charioteer Sumantra, having yoked four mind-swift horses to the chariot, then respectfully requested Vaidehi to ascend it.
